title: Interface Rebuild
summary: YTIntel has been rebuilt visually as a serious research workspace, with faster navigation, clearer evidence hierarchy and a much stronger desktop and mobile experience.
discord_changes: New premium research workspace with desktop sidebar and cleaner mobile navigation.
Added a Radar → Analyse → Validate → Package workflow rail plus Cmd/Ctrl + K Quick Switch.
Rebuilt cards, evidence states, forms, loading, tables, accessibility and the installed app identity.
changes: Rebuilt the desktop shell around a persistent research sidebar instead of a long horizontal tab strip.
Reworked tablet and mobile navigation with compact touch-first controls and reduced horizontal clutter.
Added a contextual Discover → Investigate → Validate → Package workflow rail across the core research tools.
Added a Cmd/Ctrl + K Quick Switch command palette for instant navigation to Analyse, Radar, Packaging Lab, Pattern Mine, History, Similar Videos, Visuals and Updates.
Rebuilt the visual hierarchy with calmer neutral surfaces, less border noise, stronger typography and more deliberate use of the YTIntel red accent.
Improved evidence density across metrics, pills, nested evidence cards, tables, transcripts, heatmaps and source notes.
Added cleaner loading, error and empty states so long-running research feels intentional instead of frozen.
Added clearer keyboard focus, semantic navigation, a skip link, reduced-motion support and larger touch targets.
Added live-status treatment that keeps the current app version visible even when older async health modules update the status text.
Rebuilt the What's New experience so the current release wins over older async popup handlers.
Replaced the old app icon with a cleaner premium YT monogram and refreshed PWA name, description, theme and cache.
Preserved all existing Opportunity Radar, Deep Analyse, Replication Check, Decision Gate, Pattern Mine and Packaging Lab functionality underneath the new shell.
why_it_matters: YTIntel had outgrown its prototype interface. The product now has enough intelligence and workflow depth that navigation, hierarchy and evidence readability directly affect whether users can act on the research. v0.13 makes the interface match the seriousness of the underlying system without removing the evidence guardrails.
